name: Indianapolis International Airport
before:
Indiana's busiest airport, seven miles south west of downtown Indianapolis, with more than 50 non-stop destinations across North America, the Caribbean and Europe. It carried 5,180,917 passengers in 2024.

Freight is where it really counts. This is the second largest FedEx Express hub in the world, behind only Memphis, and that keeps the airport consistently among the ten busiest in the United States for air cargo.

The terminal opened in 2008 and was one of the first in the country designed and built after the September 11 attacks. There is a single terminal with two concourses and 39 gates, and international arrivals are handled in Concourse A.

A hotel is on the way. A 253 room Westin, connected directly to the terminal parking garage, broke ground in June 2025 and is due in December 2027, with a seventh floor lounge overlooking the airfield that will be open to the public.

Republic Airways is headquartered here and Allegiant Air keeps an operating base.
after:
Indiana's busiest airport, seven miles south west of downtown Indianapolis, with more than 50 non-stop destinations across North America, the Caribbean and Europe. It handled more than 10.6 million passengers in 2025.

Freight is where it really counts. This is the second largest FedEx Express hub in the world, and that keeps the airport consistently among the ten busiest in the United States for air cargo.

The terminal opened in 2008 and was one of the first in the country designed and built after the September 11 attacks. There is a single terminal with two concourses and 39 gates, and international arrivals are handled in Concourse A.

A hotel is on the way. The 253-room Westin, connected directly to the terminal parking garage, broke ground in June 2025 and is due to open by the end of 2027, with a seventh floor bar and lounge.

claims.why: Out of date: Republic's own site gives its address as 2 Brickyard Lane, Carmel, Indiana, the new Republic Airways Aviation Campus that holds its corporate headquarters, training centre and hotel. Carmel is north of Indianapolis, not at the airport. Not replaced: a UK agent does not need Republic's head office.

claims.why: Nothing from the last 12 months confirms the base: the operator's release on it is from 2018 and its 2025 annual report lists Allegiant's routes, not a base. Allegiant's own site shows a Cloudflare bot check ('Just a moment...') and was not read further.
